standard_prerequisites.name: Adjoining a q-th root of the uniformizer gives a totally ramified degree q separable extension with the required uniformizer relations

core_obligations: If K has characteristic zero, the extension given by adjoining a root of pi_B^q = pi is degree q, separable, and totally ramified with the desired relations by the pull-root-uniformizer lemma (proof lines 34654-34656). If K has characteristic p, take the extension defined by z^q - pi^n z = pi^{1-q}; setting y = pi z converts it to y^q - pi^{n+q-1} y = pi, which is separable of degree q, totally ramified with ramification index q, and the uniformizer pi_B = y satisfies pi_B^q = pi + pi^n pi_B^{...} relations with suitable b, b' in B (proof lines 34657-34660).
proof_roadmap: Handle characteristic zero by adjoining a root of the uniformizer (proof lines 34654-34656).
Handle characteristic p by the explicit rescaled Artin-Schreier equation (proof lines 34657-34660).
difficulty_reason: 9 行、构造全分歧 q 次扩张：特征 0 时添 π 的 q 次根（pull-root-uniformizer 引理）；特征 p 时取显式方程 z^q − π^n z = π^{1−q}，换元 y = πz 化为 y^q − π^{n+q−1}y = π，得可分 q 次全分歧扩张、分歧指数 q，取 π_B = y 即满足 π_B^q = π + π^n b 与 π_B^q = π + π_B^{nq} b'。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。
